comment: Custom-node packs the stable-release bar names by hand: 'A staff member
reproduces a break in KJNodes, VideoHelperSuite or ComfyUI-Manager' stops a
release. This file pins those packs so CI reproduces the break instead.
KJNodes and VideoHelperSuite are pinned to the same commits as the
so a break reproduces in both suites against the same source.
nodeCount is what the pin registered when it was calibrated, recorded so a
reviewer can see the drop a failure is reporting. minNodeCount is what is
actually asserted: a floor, not the exact number, because a pack dropping a
block of nodes to a failed sub-import is the regression worth failing on,
and an exact count would also fail on a legitimate re-pin.
